title: Smoked pork salad
ingredients: 5 ounces baby spinach, trimmed (6 cups leaves)
4 cups thinly sliced Napa cabbage (from 1 medium head)
1 red bell pepper, cut lengthwise into thin strips
Curry vinaigrette - see recipe under condiments
method: Cut pork at a 45-degree angle into 1/2-inch-thick slices.
Line a large platter with dressed salad and arrange sliced pork, oranges, and avocados in rows on top.
Drizzle some vinaigrette over avocados and oranges.
